resources.string: Lets your computer read the files on this phone.
This settings page isn\'t available on this phone. Open Android Settings → Apps → Tentacle instead.
Tap Start so your computer can read files on this phone.
Allow file access below, or choose another port in Settings, then tap Start again.
Running on port %1$d. Read-only: your computer can browse and download, never change anything.
Running, but no way in yet
Connect this phone to Wi-Fi, or turn on Tailscale or Own server below.
Allow access to all files below, otherwise your computer sees empty folders.
This is the phone\'s Wi-Fi / Ethernet address. Computer access is not checked; it requires the same network without device isolation. On other networks, use Tailscale or Own server.
Shows that the server is running and when an update is ready.
So Android doesn\'t stop the server in the background.
So the server can start after a reboot. Tentacle can\'t check this setting; tap Open once.
No address yet. Connect to Wi-Fi, or turn on Tailscale or Own server.
Computers paired with the old token lose access at once. Pair them again with the new link.
Keep the link private: anyone who has it and can reach this phone can read its files.
Ask your computer for a change
Only changes to this Tentacle app and its computer tool; anything else is refused.
Describe the change you want, or what went wrong…
Shorten the text to 1000 words or CJK characters and remove control characters.
Could not save the request. Try again.
No computer has checked yet — run `tentacle requests watch` on it (see README)
The computer can only see requests while the file server is running.
The phone\'s local address works only if the computer can reach it on the same network without device isolation. For other networks, use one of these:
Start the file server to connect.
Reach this phone from anywhere in your tailnet. Works even with a VPN or proxy app on.
Tap Log in and sign in with your Tailscale account in the browser.
This phone leaves the tailnet. Logging in again needs the browser or a new auth key.
Only used for the first login
Enter a control server starting with http:// or https:// (or leave it empty), and a device name.
Slow (relayed) even though both sides are online? Your proxy app may route Tentacle through the proxy: exclude Tentacle in its per-app settings.
Waiting for the tailnet admin to approve this phone
Error: %1$s. Turn it off and on again; if it stays, check the control server under Advanced.
Reach this phone from anywhere through a Linux server you control.
Not set up yet. Paste your server info below.
Paste anything that contains your server details, such as an ssh command, an address or a URL. Tentacle fills in the fields.
Still missing: %1$s. Type it in below.
Nothing recognized. Paste text that contains an address, for example ssh tentacle@192.0.2.10.
Check the fields below, then tap Save.
The address was taken from the URL. If that site is behind a CDN, use the server\'s real IP instead.
Fill in the server address. Ports must be 1–65535 and the URL must start with http:// or https://.
%1$s points to Cloudflare. SSH can\'t pass through Cloudflare, so the tunnel will never connect. Use the server\'s real IP address (or a DNS-only name) here; the public URL can stay as it is.
On the server, add this line to ~/.ssh/authorized_keys of the user above. It allows only this tunnel.
Could not create the SSH key. Restart the app and try again.
not trusted yet (trusted on first connection)
Settings incomplete: fill in the server address and user.
Can\'t reach the server. Check the address and SSH port; retrying.
The server refused the key. Add the authorized_keys line on the server.
The server\'s key changed. If you expected that, tap Trust new host key.
The remote port is busy. Choose another remote port, or stop the other tunnel.
Uses more battery. Turn it on if transfers stop while the screen is off.
This removes the diagnostic history stored by Tentacle.
Could not read or change the app log. Try again.
Update now to get the latest fixes. Your settings stay as they are.
Updates have not been checked yet
Allow Tentacle to install updates, then tap Install update again
Confirm the installation in the system dialog…
Could not check for updates. Check the internet connection and try again.
Could not download the update. Try again later.
The downloaded update was damaged and was refused. Try again.
The update is signed by someone else and was refused. Install updates only from the official source.
The downloaded file is not a Tentacle APK and was refused.
Android could not start the installation. Try again.
Relay verification codes to the computer
Allow incoming SMS so your computer can read verification codes for 10 minutes after they arrive. Old messages are not read. Codes for payments and transfers are never relayed.

Codes stay in memory for 10 minutes. Payment, transfer and withdrawal codes are never relayed. Anyone with your phone token can read relayed codes; leave this off when not needed. The file server must be running for the computer to connect.
Optional: open notification access and allow Tentacle to read codes from app notifications.
On Android 13 and newer, sideloaded apps may first need App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings. Then return to Tentacle and try granting access again.
Also read codes from app notifications
Android 15 and newer hide codes from other apps\' notifications; this mainly helps on Android 14 and older or for codes sent inside apps.
SMS permission is needed to receive new verification messages. If access was denied or blocked, open App info → Permissions → SMS → Allow. Old messages are not read.
On Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO with MIUI or HyperOS, also allow App info → Permissions → Notification SMS (通知类短信) → Allow. This separate permission controls verification and notification messages.
Urgent alerts ring and vibrate continuously, even on the lock screen, until you tap Acknowledge (up to 2 minutes). Only use this if you want your computer to be able to wake you.
Notifications are disabled. Allow notifications so your computer can reach you.
Full-screen alerts are not allowed. Allow them to show urgent alerts over the lock screen; otherwise urgent alerts still ring and vibrate with a notification.
The computer message channel is blocked.
The urgent alert channel is blocked.
This is a test message from Tentacle.
Test notification was not shown. Check notification permissions and channel settings.
Test notification delivered. Full-screen alerts are not allowed.
Test notification failed. Try again later; notification rate limits also apply to tests.
